verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service could plausibly publish versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only the web-based SOSPortal for filing, ordering and searching, and never mentions an API, versioning, or a deprecation policy. The SOSPortal replacement of SOSDirect/SOSUpload is a product-platform migration, not an API deprecation policy, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
